quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 2026): net sales JPY 670,125 million (+8.2%). Digital Society Business net sales JPY 205,409 million (+19.7%) and operating income JPY 28,105 million (+63.5%), led by higher sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment products. Management states that demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment products rose on increased semiconductor demand for AI plus inventory build-up at some customers, and that shipments of piezoelectric microactuators for hard disk drives (HDD) stayed firm as strong data center investment continued.

quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In March 2026 the company decided to invest more than JPY 70 billion to build a new factory for ceramic products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment on land adjacent to its automotive-products plant in Ishikawa Prefecture, raising domestic production capacity by about 20%. Management states that AI expansion and the resulting growth in data volume are progressing faster than assumed, that it expects large market expansion for semiconductor manufacturing equipment products and HICERAM carriers, and that it will add production capacity through large investments.
quarterly_data.figure: investment more than JPY 70 billion; domestic capacity about +20%

quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex in FY2026 (year ended March 2026) was JPY 55,848 million for the group, of which JPY 22,873 million in the Digital Society Business, mainly production equipment for semiconductor manufacturing equipment products and electronic products. Planned investment for the following year: JPY 62,000 million, including JPY 24,000 million in the Digital Society Business for production equipment additions and upgrades (semiconductor manufacturing equipment products and electronic products), JPY 15,000 million in the Environment Business and JPY 20,000 million in corporate R&D facilities.

quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 2026) group R&D expense JPY 31,786 million; Digital Society Business R&D JPY 4,640 million on ceramic parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment for higher-performance semiconductors, ceramic support wafers used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, piezoelectric elements for data center HDDs, composite wafers for telecommunications and beryllium copper foil for data centers. Corporate R&D (JPY 16,798 million) themes include sub-nano ceramic membranes, next-generation composite wafers and HICERAM carriers. The company plans about JPY 200 billion of R&D over the five years from 2026 (JPY 142.6 billion spent in the past five years).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 31,786 million; Digital Society R&D JPY 4,640 million; R&D plan about JPY 200 billion over five years

quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company targets: new-business product sales of JPY 100 billion or more in 2030 ('New Value 1000'); ROE target raised to 12% for fiscal 2030 as the company numbers it (FY2026 ROE 7.8%), with the Digital Society Business positioned as the growth driver. Portfolio moves: in October 2025 the company decided to end manufacturing and sales of NAS batteries and take no new orders (business restructuring cost JPY 19,959 million booked as an extraordinary loss) and to reorganize the ceramic package business (NGK Electrodevices' sales division transferred to the company on April 1, 2026; that division's FY2026 sales JPY 15,436 million); in April 2026 the company changed its name to NGK Corporation; on January 29, 2026 it terminated its February 2025 agreement to acquire Deutsche KNM GmbH (heat exchangers, membrane equipment) from KNM Process Systems.
quarterly_data.figure: New Value 1000 target JPY 100 billion+ (2030); ROE target 12%; NAS restructuring cost JPY 19,959 million
